question:
Select the most appropriate option fill in the blank.

The death of her father had made her sullen and _______ .
solution:
The correct answer is **'Melancholic'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is** 'melancholic'.**
 
• **Melancholic **means feeling or expressing pensive sadness(गहन उदासी महसूस करना या व्यक्त करना).
 
 
• **Example: **His work often has a wistful or **melancholic **mood.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Let us understand the meaning of the other options:**

 
 
• **​Jovial - **happy and friendly.(खुश और मिलनसार)
 
• **Smug** - too pleased with yourself.(अपने आप से बहुत प्रसन्न।)
 
• **Joyful -** very happy.(बहुत खुश)
 
 

**Hence, **the correct sentence is *The death of her father had made her sullen and **melancholic.***
